target: Low-poly growth-stage models (bibit/tumbuh/siap) for all 12 crops in Config/Crops, shown in an in-world showcase behind an off-by-default LookDev candidate
candidateRule: all models CANDIDATES awaiting designer yes/no; not approved, not shipped on by default
approach: Pure-data low-poly recipes (Roblox primitive parts) rather than imported meshes: subagent transport was down and place saves are forbidden. Durable in Rojo, reversible, no asset IDs, no place save.

implementation.recipeSource: src/shared/CropModelCandidates.luau (pure data: palette + 12 archetypes + partsFor(cropId, stage), no asset IDs)
implementation.lookDevCandidate: crops (pure data only, idsSource pointer, stageCount=3, cropCount=12, no numeric IDs)
implementation.default: off - shipping crop visuals from FarmService untouched
implementation.showcase: floating 6-column grid near the player, destroyed on disable

studioRoundTrip.method: Play Solo, fresh Client VM; require Shared.LookDev + Shared.CropModelCandidates + the LookDevCrops adapter from LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts, then LookDev.enable('crops')/disable()
studioRoundTrip.note: The restricted Studio MCP execute_luau VM has no Enum.PartType shape members; shapeOf() resolves under pcall and leaves Parts at default Block on failure. Real LocalScript VM resolves Cylinder/Sphere/Wedge. All 36 models still build and the toggle is fully proven.
studioRoundTrip.partCountNote: 339 = 303 recipe parts from partsFor() + 36 Soil base parts (BillboardGui labels are not BaseParts). Confirmed expectedParts=303 from the same partsFor() the adapter uses.

render.note: Front-elevation schematic generated by dumping partsFor() from CropModelCandidates.luau via Lune and drawing all 12 crops x 3 stages from that SAME data, so render cannot drift from shipped models. A review aid, NOT a Studio screenshot. No agent visually graded the art.

validation.lune: All 1950 tests passed (up from 1944; 6 new crop/LookDev specs)
